title: Zesty Mediterranean Lamb Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic pilaf dish featuring lamb, rice, and Mediterranean staples, perfect for a romantic dinner
instructions: Heat olive oil in a salt block over medium-high heat.
Add lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove lamb from pot and set aside.
Add chopped onion to pot and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add white rice to pot and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add chicken broth to pot and bring to a boil.
Add browned lamb back to pot, cover, and reduce heat to low.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in chopped parsley, mint, lemon juice, and lemon zest.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
